title: A Data-Consistent Approach to Ensemble Filtering
summary: Ensemble data assimilation is challenging when the ensemble size is substantially smaller than the state and observation dimensions, leaving empirical covariance information rank deficient and sensitive to finite sampling. We introduce the Quantity-of-Interest Principal Component Analysis Ensemble Data-Consistent Filter (QPCA-EnDCF), a deterministic filtering method motivated by data-consistent inversion that regularizes the update in the whitened forecast--observation mismatch space.
